title: TransportEnvelope
description: The three WebSocket frame shapes exchanged between the laptop (server) and the phone (client); see docs/camera-sync-design.md Sec 4.2 and contracts/README.md 'Transport envelope'. The reserved types 'health' and 'location' (phone -> laptop, defined in later steps) and any other unrecognised 'type' are valid JSON that a receiver logs and ignores -- they are deliberately out of scope for this schema, which only documents the three shapes the laptop and phone actually exchange today.

t1.description: Laptop send time, integer Unix-epoch milliseconds.
Echoed laptop send time, integer Unix-epoch milliseconds.

t2.description: Phone receive time, integer Unix-epoch milliseconds.

t3.description: Phone send time, integer Unix-epoch milliseconds.
